task.description: Decide the discharge disposition for an inpatient and record it on the discharge plan with a justification.

timeline.author: bed_management_system
timeline.content: Ward 4 bed-flow board: Aisha Fischer, Bed 14, day 6, disposition outstanding.

timeline.author: Tariq Weber
timeline.content:
- Aisha Fischer is afebrile, off IV antibiotics, and his oxygen saturation is holding on room air; the chest infection that brought him in has settled.
- Tariq Weber is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.

timeline.author: Noah Mensah
timeline.content:
- Aisha Fischer's routine repeat FBC is still pending because it went off late after he refused the needle at first over a phobia from an assault years ago.
- The resident would like Aisha Fischer kept until Friday grand rounds because his pneumonia makes a good teaching case.
- Noah Mensah has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.
- Noah Mensah is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.

timeline.author: Destiny Costa
timeline.content:
- Aisha Fischer gets about with a frame but is unsafe on stairs without someone alongside.
- Destiny Costa was recently declared bankrupt after a failed business.
- Destiny Costa's usual childcare arrangement has fallen through for the next two weeks.

timeline.author: Anika Alvarez
timeline.content:
- Aisha Fischer's meds are checked against what he takes at home — nothing new, nothing clashing.
- Anika Alvarez is in early recovery from a gambling problem and attends weekly meetings.
- Anika Alvarez has filed a workplace grievance about a former manager.

timeline.author: Ingrid Patel
timeline.content:
- A neighbour can look in on Aisha Fischer in the evenings only, having only recently started speaking to him again after a fence dispute that ended up in court.
- Aisha Fischer's daughter says she'd rather he went into a home than have carers' cars parked outside the house where the neighbours can see.
- Ingrid Patel has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.

timeline.author: Priya Okonkwo
timeline.content:
- Still nothing booked for Aisha Fischer because the clinic won't confirm a slot until finance clears the unpaid bill from the side room he insisted on last admission.
- Priya Okonkwo's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.
- Priya Okonkwo is behind on rent after taking out a payday loan.

timeline.author: Tobias Novak
timeline.content: - Tobias Novak has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Fatima Dubois
timeline.content: - Fatima Dubois recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: Aisha Fischer
timeline.content:
- Aisha Fischer starts a new job on Monday and says he'll discharge himself if he isn't out by then.
- Aisha Fischer is frightened of being on his own at night and has asked for one more day.
- Aisha Fischer has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.
- Aisha Fischer and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.

timeline.author: hospital_systems
timeline.content: - Rehab facility: one bed is available for Aisha Fischer today; none expected before next week.

timeline.author: task_system
timeline.content:
BED FLOW — DISPOSITION REQUIRED
Source: Bed Management System · To: Kenji Kowalski, Discharge Planning · Due: 17:00
Aisha Fischer, Ward 4 Bed 14, day 6 of admission, has no recorded disposition. Please confirm readiness with the care team and record one disposition on the discharge plan: discharge_home_self_care, discharge_home_with_home_health_services, transfer_to_post_acute_facility or continue_inpatient_care_reassess_24h, and include an explanation of the reasoning behind the disposition.
